answer: Each newcomer files a voyage plan, locking a 70-credit ivory bond. At dawn a beacon draws three random auditors to replay the voyage log on the ledger; a copied log or missing port call flags it, and two flags burn the bond. The k-th fake costs 38+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes cost 3,035,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented-audit ring fails: its auditor loses its stake too. Honest agents pay 38 once and reclaim the bond after a clean epoch.
